facts.c: BMET granted emigration clearance to 15,921 Bangladeshis for Cambodia over the 18 months to July 2026
facts.q: Over the past 18 months, the Bureau of Manpower, Employment and Training (BMET) granted official emigration clearance to 15,921 Bangladeshis to travel to Cambodia.

facts.c: BRAC data: more than 1,000 BMET-cleared Bangladeshis remain trapped in cyber scam compounds in Cambodia
facts.q: more than 1,000 of these individuals remain trapped inside cyber scam compounds

facts.c: Recruiters charge up to Tk 5.3 lakh for promised IT and computer operator jobs in Cambodia
facts.q: Recruiters routinely charge job seekers up to Tk5.3 lakh for promised IT and computer operator roles

facts.c: A Lakshmipur victim paid a recruiting agency and local brokers Tk 5.3 lakh, got BMET clearance, but received no work permit in Cambodia and was sold to a scam compound
facts.q: Upon arrival, he did not receive a work permit and was later sold to a cyber scam compound.

facts.c: A Chapainawabganj worker paid Tk 4.8 lakh through a local middleman and Fahim Recruiting Agency, got a BMET clearance card and a valid work visa, and endured 10 months of hardship in Cambodia
facts.q: He was recruited through Fahim Recruiting Agency, which has sent around 200 workers to Cambodia over the past year.

facts.c: Normally a foreign employer's demand letter must be attested by the Bangladeshi embassy before recruiting; the agency then obtains BMET clearance
facts.q: Under standard protocols, foreign employers must have their worker demand letters attested by the relevant Bangladeshi embassy before recruiting.

facts.c: A small-batch exemption lets up to five workers migrate without embassy attestation; syndicates split orders to use it, and 70-75% of current workers migrate under it
facts.q: the policy allows up to five workers to migrate without embassy attestation

facts.c: State Minister Nurul Hoque (July 2026): for Cambodia, Laos and Brazil the attestation exemption ends; proper work visas and full verification are required before BMET clearance; no blanket ban
facts.q: For these destinations, we have decided that workers will no longer be allowed to migrate under the embassy attestation exemption. Proper work visas and full verification will be mandatory before BMET clearance is issued

facts.c: Fahim Recruiting Agency's proprietor says some workers leave assigned employers for better pay and some become unreachable after arrival, and only three workers complained against the agency at BMET
facts.q: Only three workers have lodged complaints against us in BMET

facts.c: 221 Bangladeshis rescued from Cambodian scam compounds returned in four days in June 2026, the last group on Thai Airways TG-339
facts.q: The latest group arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on a Thai Airways flight (TG-339).

facts.c: Returnees got emergency support and money to travel home from Civil Aviation Security and BRAC's Migration Program at the airport
facts.q: the returnees received emergency support and financial assistance to travel home through the efforts of Civil Aviation Security and Brac's Migration Program at the airport

facts.c: A returnee paid Tk 550,000 to brokers, travelled with BMET clearance but was let into Cambodia on a visit visa that was never renewed, found no company or job, and was sold to a scam compound
facts.q: He said he travelled with BMET clearance but was allowed to enter Cambodia on a visit visa, which was never renewed.

facts.c: Cambodia let foreigners who overstayed leave voluntarily without fines from 1 September 2026
facts.q: the Cambodian government began allowing foreigners staying beyond their permitted period to leave voluntarily without paying fines from Sept 1

facts.c: 38 Bangladeshis returned from Cambodia on 3 Sep 2026; BRAC said about 1,800 were still waiting, after 583 came home in June
facts.q: around 1,800 Bangladeshis are still waiting to return after 583 came home from Cambodia in June

facts.c: Many of the 583 who returned in June 2026 had BMET clearance
facts.q: Many of the 583 Bangladeshis who returned in June had BMET clearance

facts.c: BRAC gives returnees from Cambodia emergency help, counselling and money to reach home
facts.q: BRAC’s Migration Programme provided the returnees with emergency assistance, counselling and financial support to help them reach their homes.

facts.c: Returnees say some Bangladeshis involved in trafficking in Cambodia intimidate victims trying to return home
facts.q: some Bangladeshis involved in human trafficking in Cambodia intimidate and pressure victims trying to return home

facts.c: Cambodia's General Department of Immigration deported 52,039 foreigners from 87 countries in January-September 2026, including more than 3,000 Bangladeshis (BTV via Anirban)
facts.q: Among the deported were about 23,000 Chinese, more than 8,000 Indonesians, more than 4,000 Vietnamese and more than 3,000 Bangladeshi citizens.

facts.c: Per BMET, 12,263 Bangladeshis took clearance for Cambodia in 2025, making it Bangladesh's 8th labour market that year
